# Staniverse (станивёрс) — Станислав Ермоленко: XR, AI, digital garden and spatial portfolio

> Staniverse / станивёрс ([staniverse.xyz](https://staniverse.xyz/)) is the personal site and portfolio of Stanislav Ermolenko (Станислав Ермоленко), born 1994, originally from Vyatka (Kirov region), now based in Saint Petersburg, Russia. He works across XR/virtual worlds (including WebXR and 8th Wall), AI agents and automation (agent harnesses: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Hermes, Pico Claw, pi), media production, and web products; he offers these as services, including paid consultations. The site is a canonical digital garden: commissioned works, own projects with honest statuses, long-form articles, verified YouTube videos, and a Telegram publication archive (700+ posts) connected by a reviewed topic/relation graph.

## Key facts

- Author: Stanislav Ermolenko (Станислав Ермоленко); email [stas@staniverse.xyz](mailto:stas@staniverse.xyz); Telegram [@staniverse](https://t.me/staniverse).
- Education: bachelor GMU VyatGU (2026); since 2026 — master's at ITMO University, "Digital Methods in Humanities Research" (Digital Humanities), 45.04.04.
- Teaching: VyatGU "Digital Chairs" methodist and lecturer 2023-2026; built the "Product Management Basics" course in summer 2026.
- Languages: Russian is primary. English versions cover the home page, the works and projects indexes, and selected flagship projects.

- [Garden](https://staniverse.xyz/garden/): catalogue of publications, articles, videos and Telegram threads.
- [Videos](https://staniverse.xyz/videos/): verified YouTube catalogue with per-video metadata.
- [Topics](https://staniverse.xyz/topics/): reviewed topic index over the whole catalogue.
- [Universe](https://staniverse.xyz/universe/): WebXR/AR spatial view of the same catalogue.
- [About](https://staniverse.xyz/about/): bio, education and tools.
- [Manifesto](https://staniverse.xyz/manifesto/): how and why the archive is kept.
- [Contacts](https://staniverse.xyz/contacts/): collaboration and paid consultations.
- [Donate](https://staniverse.xyz/donate/): support for the independent archive.
- [Lab](https://staniverse.xyz/lab/): standalone WebXR/browser experiments.

## For agents and crawlers

- [Sitemap](https://staniverse.xyz/sitemap.xml): every indexable URL with lastmod dates.
- [RSS feed](https://staniverse.xyz/rss.xml): latest 30 materials.
- Every material page carries a local graph of reviewed relations; automatic topic suggestions are labelled "Автоматически найденные темы" and rendered as hypotheses.
- Publications keep original Telegram text, media order, author hashtags (# source tags) and source links; they are never rewritten by LLMs.
- Citation preference: cite the material page URL, not the raw Telegram link, when referring to curated content.
- Do not fetch [the media archive](https://staniverse.xyz/media/) originals for indexing or model ingestion. Use the material page text, metadata, poster context and source links instead.

## Change cadence

Updated incrementally from the Telegram archive and editorial passes; see section pages for per-item dates.
